kebab_example: aliyun eds-user create-resource-group --resource-group-name '部门A资源组' --resource-group-description '部门A资源组' --is-resource-group-with-office-site 0 --platform AliyunConsole --business-channel ENTERPRISE --enable-aliyun-resource-group true --resource-classification Default --agent-type JVSClaw --api-version 2021-03-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the resource group. This parameter is optional. The description can be up to 500 characters in length and is saved as-is
parameters.help_zh: 资源组描述，可选，最多 500 个字符，按原值保存
parameters.name: resource_group_description

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not publicly available
parameters.help_zh: 该参数不对外开放使用
parameters.name: is_resource_group_with_office_site

parameters.help_en: For Elastic Desktop Service Enterprise Edition, set the value to `AliyunConsole`. Other platforms are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 对于无影云电脑企业版，固定传入`AliyunConsole`。其他平台暂不支持
parameters.name: platform

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to create an Alibaba Cloud resource group at the same time. This is supported only for resource groups in the Default category
parameters.help_zh: 是否同时创建阿里云资源组。仅 Default 分类的资源组支持
parameters.name: enable_aliyun_resource_group

parameters.help_en: The agent subtype of the DesktopAgent resource group. Valid values: JVSClaw and HermesAgent
parameters.help_zh: DesktopAgent 资源组的 Agent 子类型，可选 JVSClaw 或 HermesAgent
parameters.name: agent_type
